Verify that the [DONE] sentinel signal properly terminates the stream

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Say done', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4', stream: true)).to_a
puts result.inspect
```
